title: The Room That Doesn't Exist
logline: A man hears knocking inside his bedroom wall every night at 3:17 AM. On the seventh night, police find a sealed room that was never on any blueprint.

segments.text: For seven nights, Daniel Hale heard knocking inside his bedroom wall. Always at {3:17|three seventeen}.
Welcome to the Midnight Archive. I'm Elias Voss. This is file {001|zero zero one}.
Daniel lived alone. Behind his bed was nothing but solid brick... or so the landlord swore.
Three slow knocks, every night. On the fourth night, Daniel knocked back. Something answered.
On the seventh night, the police cut open the wall. Behind the plaster was a door. Sealed... from the inside.
Beyond it was a room no blueprint had ever shown. Empty, except for an old tape recorder. Still playing.
The voice on the tape was Daniel's own. Hoarse. Terrified.
Don't turn around. Please... don't turn around.
On the far wall hung an old mirror. In it, Daniel's reflection was smiling. Daniel was not.
It wasn't his reflection. Something was standing right behind him... so close, its face covered his own in the glass.
It was never knocking to get out. It was knocking to see if anyone was home.
The officers left at {3:16|three sixteen}. Daniel Hale was never seen again. If something knocks tonight... don't answer. File closed.
